name: Docusign
summary: Building is free in the developer sandbox; going live needs a paid production Docusign account. The old 20-API-call rule is gone: Go-Live runs automatic checks and eligible apps are promoted instantly. Public apps need the Partner Program. Composio has no managed Docusign app.

composio.note: Composio lists this toolkit but you must bring your own OAuth app.

steps.title: Create a free developer account
steps.detail: Sandbox at account-d.docusign.com, API base demo.docusign.net.

steps.title: Create the integration key
steps.detail: Apps & Keys → Add app: Authorization Code Grant, secret, redirect URI (Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback).
steps.agent: Prepare the settings and test consent in the sandbox

steps.title: Build against the sandbox the production way
steps.detail: Read each user's `base_uri` from /oauth/userinfo once and cache it; production hosts differ per data centre. Use webhooks, not polling.
steps.agent: Implement OAuth, base_uri discovery and Connect webhooks

steps.title: Get a paid production account with admin access
steps.detail: Trial plans aren't eligible. ISV partners can apply for a free management account.
steps.human: Buy or pick a supported plan; make sure you're an admin

steps.title: Choose the integration classification
steps.detail: Private custom, third-party key, public (Partner Program) or embedded (ISV Embed licence). It also decides how envelopes are billed.
steps.agent: Recommend the classification from your business model

steps.title: Join the Docusign Partner Program
steps.detail: Required for a public integration that other companies authorize with their own accounts.

steps.title: Run Go-Live
steps.detail: Pick the production account. Eligible apps go live instantly; others go to Pending approval. "Verification required" means the account admin must verify their identity once.
steps.agent: Pre-check eligibility and draft the review notes
steps.human: Start Go-Live and complete identity verification

steps.title: Re-enter secrets and redirect URIs in production
steps.detail: The key is copied to production, but secrets and redirect URIs are not.
steps.agent: Script the production config and switch base URIs

launchToday: Composio can't host this one: bring your own integration key.
If you already have a paid Docusign account, Go-Live can be same-day.
rejections: Trying to go live from a trial plan
Admin identity verification not completed (status: Declined, Verification required)
Wrong classification for the business model
API rule or resource-limit violations such as polling

blockers.problem: Production calls fail right after Go-Live
blockers.fix: Secrets and redirect URIs aren't copied with the key. Add them in production and use the account's base_uri.
The production account admin completes the one-time identity verification, then re-select the Go-Live account.

uncertain: Docusign doesn't say which integrations are auto-promoted vs reviewed, or how long a manual review takes (0–5 days is our estimate).
Partner Program approval time isn't published.
